items.text: Steelers officially placed Michael Pittman Jr. on IR (foot/plantar fasciitis); misses minimum four games.
items.why: Official roster move confirming multi-week absence
items.implication: PIT WR room reshuffle for extended period
items.opportunity: Increased targets to DK Metcalf, other Steelers pass-catchers

items.text: Cardinals finalizing trade of WR Marvin Harrison Jr.; informed he will be inactive Sunday vs DET as details finalized. Houston in mix (possible Stroud reunion). Seeking ~2nd round+ value. No trade completed until after Sunday games.
items.why: Team decision amid trade finalization; low production (5 catches/4 games)
items.implication: MHJ out of AZ offense immediately and long-term; destination TBD post-Sunday
items.opportunity: Immediate target/route share boost for Michael Wilson and remaining AZ WRs; reverse any MHJ-dependent plans

items.text: Saquon Barkley listed OUT on ETR Sunday fantasy injuries board (hamstring), along with DeVonta Smith and Hollywood Brown for Eagles.
items.implication: Eagles RB/WR depth thinned significantly for London game; primary back role opens
items.opportunity: Increased carries/snaps for remaining Eagles RBs; more targets to other WRs/TE

items.text: Lamar Jackson listed OUT on ETR board; Tyler Huntley expected to start.
items.why: Ankle injury, confirmed OUT on final board and Rapoport report
items.implication: Major downgrade to Ravens offense efficiency and scoring
items.opportunity: Potential volume uptick for Derrick Henry, Zay Flowers, Mark Andrews, Isaiah Likely in modified scheme

items.text: Breece Hall and AD Mitchell listed OUT.
items.implication: Jets backfield and WR depth impacted
items.opportunity: Elevated role for remaining Jets RBs and Garrett Wilson targets

items.text: Stefon Diggs, Quentin Johnston, Michael Pittman listed OUT; Pittman later confirmed IR by Schefter (min 4 games, foot).
items.why: ETR board + Schefter IR confirmation for Pittman
items.implication: Significant WR absences for WAS, LAC, PIT
items.opportunity: Target/share increases for remaining WRs/TEs on those teams

items.text: Ashton Jeanty questionable (foot/ankle); Raiders elevated RB Roman Hemby.
items.why: New/added foot issue + ankle; elevation of backup signals uncertainty
items.implication: Game-time risk; if OUT, clear path for Hemby/committee
items.opportunity: Handcuff elevation; monitor for Jeanty snap share if active (efficiency already dipped)

items.text: MHJ has only 5 catches in 4 games and wasn't a real factor; trade/inactive makes it Kia Kendrick Bourne / Michael Wilson szn. No pleasure informing of the shift.
items.implication: Wilson (and Bourne) become primary AZ WR options with expanded opportunity
items.opportunity: Routes/targets/red-zone previously split now consolidate to Wilson et al.

items.text: Jeremiyah Love, Jayden Daniels, Chris Olave, Dallas Goedert listed IN (cleared).
items.why: Final board designation after practice participation
items.implication: Full or near-full roles expected; reverse any prior handcuff/backup elevations
items.opportunity: Love workload secure; Daniels QB1 back; Olave/Goedert target share restored

items.text: Messy QUESTIONABLE list includes Ja'Marr Chase, Tee Higgins, Justin Jefferson, Jordan Addison, Ashton Jeanty, Ladd McConkey, Zay Flowers, Terry McLaurin, Alvin Kamara, Rhamondre Stevenson, Rico Dowdle, Carnell Tate. Levitan notes ridiculous Q list bracing for messy Sunday AM.
items.why: ETR comprehensive Friday board; many limited/DNP earlier
items.implication: High variance Sunday; monitor AM reports/inactives closely for start/sit
items.opportunity: If OUT, clear beneficiaries in each offense (e.g. Jeanty absence elevates Hemby)

items.text: Jeremiyah Love (ankle maintenance, limited practice but not on final IR, 'full-go') projected 4.8 DK points clear of Allgeier. Post-Week4 usage criticism may boost role; tougher projection spot with downside risk but gut says much better workload this week.
items.why: Cleared final report + response to prior low usage criticism; ankle managed
items.implication: Strong RB2/flex with clear lead over committee mate
items.opportunity: Higher snap/carry/route share expected vs recent weeks

items.text: Week 5 Loves (per-player): Nico Collins WR8 @TEN (volume/RZ/matchup); Michael Wilson vs DET WR10 (volume post-MHJ); Christian Watson vs CHI WR15; Isaiah Likely @WSH TE5; Chase Brown @MIA RB5 (usage + Bengals WR injuries boost). Others: Carnell Tate, etc.
items.why: Target hogs, red-zone, soft matchups, complementary injury boosts (Brown via Chase/Higgins Q)
items.implication: Strong start recommendations with ranking bumps
items.opportunity: Collins/Wilson volume; Brown RB workload/opportunity; Likely TE upside with Lamar out

items.text: Week 5 Hates (per-player): Jordan Addison @NO (WR41, injury wrinkle + matchup/role); Mark Andrews @ATL (TE17); Cam Skattebo @WSH (RB20 efficiency/game env); Tony Pollard vs HOU (RB28); Jalen Hurts vs JAX London (QB15, rough stretch + line).
items.why: Tough matchups, thin/inefficient roles, usage data, injury concerns, environment
items.implication: Fade/sit in most formats this week

items.text: Hate saying negative on great player like Malik Nabers but long-term multi-risk stack: knee becomes issue, can't shake shoulder, JJ McCarthy under center, coaching (Harbaugh/Nagy/Roman) boomer tendencies. Short-term play still fine.
items.why: Sore knee (missed practice), prior shoulder, QB/coaching uncertainty stacking
items.implication: Monitor closely ROS; not pure set-and-forget elite
items.conflict: Usage still strong short-term vs long-term flags
